analyst_view.overall: Early view: a straight fight for a play-off place, with OFI (16th) and Anderlecht (15th) both on 6 points. Anderlecht have won their last two without conceding, OFI won 2-0 at Hapoel Beer Sheva, and both sit fifth in their domestic leagues; none of the two sides' eight league-phase games has had more than three goals.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals, and the results agree: OFI's games have finished 2-0, 1-2, 0-2 and 2-0, Anderlecht's 1-2, 0-1, 3-0 and 2-0. With so much riding on it for both, I'd expect a tight game decided by a goal.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. OFI's home games against Hoffenheim and Leverkusen were very different (one win, one defeat), and Anderlecht are dangerous from set pieces, with Ludwig Augustinsson's free kick opening the scoring against Salzburg, so corners should be shared and near the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. I lean a little higher: the Pankritio will be loud for a game that could decide which of the two goes through, and evenly matched sides fighting over the same prize tend to pick up more tactical fouls late on.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, with Anderlecht the busier side. That looks right for a visiting team in form, though OFI at home are capable of more than the site's 10.6, so the total should land near the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. OFI have been efficient (two goals at Hapoel from Achilles Fongaras and Taxiarchis Fountas) and Anderlecht have scored five in two games, but both defences are in good shape, so I stay with the number.
